title: People missing from native cultures, traced in census data

tellings.quote: heard there are uh people sometimes mysteriously missing from those native cultures. Um I know somebody who studies this in census data.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a PhD, says he has heard that people sometimes go missing mysteriously from native cultures. Michels says he knows someone who studies these disappearances using census data. If true, it would mean these vanishings leave a trace in the population counts.
